text: If you 3D print, this Fantic Rotary Tool is one that you are going to want to add to your Christmas list. This was on my Christmas list last year and I picked it up at Black Friday Pricing and it has been an excellent tool for me. There are times that I will 3D print something, it will come out with a rough edge or it will have pieces that need to go together but they just don't quite fit. This is exactly what you need. It all comes in this compact little case including all these little tool heads which are magnetic and clip right back into place. These have a variety of different grits and textures so you can really fine tune your work. In this case, I 3D printed this little alien and it has a tiny little square that you insert between the two pieces to fit it together and it just didn't quite fit. I was able to use this tool to round off the edges and save the print. I'm done, I put it all back in this case, put it in the drawer, done. So great to have on hand to save a print.
